prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of the element Helium (헬륨) itself — the sovereign of the Helium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Helium (He) to carry in her design and the scene: the lightest noble gas: aloof and never reacting with anything, yet always lifting — balloons, airships, feet hovering just above the ground; first found not on Earth but in sunlight, as a single golden spectral line at the edge of an eclipsed sun; a gas-discharge tube glowing soft peach-pink; chilled near absolute zero it becomes a superfluid that creeps up the walls of its glass. Palette: pale peach-pink discharge glow, cloud white, high-altitude sky blue, a thin golden spectral line.
AGE: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
SILHOUETTE: slender and full-busted, narrow-waisted build; a short tousled pixie cut with choppy uneven bangs; pale peach-pink hair glowing softly like a gas-discharge tube.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a soft, gentle warmth; fair skin; diamond-shaped face; moderately sized eyes — narrow upturned eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; soft rounded brows; straight narrow nose; full heart-shaped lips; pale peach-pink eyes; softly tinted lips; adult game-illustration facial proportions, not a chibi or moe anime face.
WORLD — MECHA: year 2200, a lunar helium-3 mining colony: regolith harvesters crawling over grey dunes, fusion-reactor domes glowing peach-pink, the blue Earth hanging in a black sky. MECHA DESIGN: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. cloud-white and pale peach armor with rounded balloon-like pauldrons, ring units hovering weightless around her waist and wrists, soft peach-pink discharge glow lines, a clear visor ring, frost-white superfluid shimmer at the joints, heels that never quite touch the ground; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D anime game key art: very fine, thin linework used only as light accents on the eyes, brows and lips, with the face, body and costume shaped mainly by painted cel-to-soft shading with clear shadow shapes. Matte hand-painted skin, not airbrushed, not a glossy 3D render, no soft-focus glow on the face. Anime facial design that keeps each character's own facial structure, eye proportions and skin tone instead of one house face. Crisp costume and prop detail with strong colour contrast; the background is painted in soft, detailed brushwork without outlines. A vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting. Not flat 2D cel anime, not semi-realistic.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (He) and atomic number (2) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
